m14.text: Zurbit, Relno's one-eyed homunculus attendant, discovers the tower ransacked and a window pried open by merfolk who made off with the lot.
He rows with Pip to the merfolk reef and drops a message in a flask, and a merfolk surfaces to hiss at him with contempt.

He then gives Pip a green potion and pushes him out over the reef as the cat grows to the size of a small whale, and when Relno returns to find the tower in disarray, Zurbit claims he was just letting in some sea air.
